This week, the Senate Judiciary Committee will begin the confirmation process for Acting Attorney General @DAGToddBlanche, who has my full support.

It’s imperative that we swiftly confirm him so he can continue the work of fighting crime, dismantling drug cartels, combating fraud, and keeping our communities safe.
posts.summary: Backs swift confirmation of Todd Blanche as Attorney General

I’m thankful to Governor McMaster for his appointment and President Trump for his steadfast support of Lindsey’s sister, Darline, to serve out the remainder of this Congress. There is no one more fitting to finish Lindsey’s term than Darline, whom he loved dearly and who understands the needs of South Carolinians so deeply.

I stand ready to welcome Darline to the Senate and work alongside her to continue the work of my dear friend. There is no doubt that Lindsey will be smiling down from above

posts.text: Two years ago today, our nation witnessed a day that will forever be cemented in history when an assassination attempt was carried out against President Trump. By the grace of God, President Trump survived and emerged stronger than ever. His commitment to serving our country and making the lives of Americans more prosperous has never been more important.

After years of delays, the Mobile River Bridge and Bayway project is finally moving toward construction. This is a major win for Mobile, Baldwin County, the Gulf Coast, and the entire Southeast.

Thanks to President Trump’s leadership, Alabama is one step closer to delivering this transformational infrastructure project.
